## Winnie Waltz — G4 background filly

Winnie Waltz is the mint-green Earth-pony filly with a rosy-pink mane, orange-peach eyes, and a *musical triangle* cutie mark. She's easiest to recognize among Hoofer Steps' young dancers when Apple Bloom visits their studio in *On Your Marks*. She later reappears among the School of Friendship's pupils.

“Winnie Waltz” is a fandom/wiki placeholder, not a verified name spoken in the series or confirmed by Hasbro. The [MLP Wiki foal roster](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) identifies her and lists her appearances; the original person who coined the nickname is not established. No distinct spoken lines or voice actor are verified. She has no established alternate identity.

*On-screen appearances:* *On Your Marks* (S6E4); *A Matter of Principals* (S8E14); *School Raze – Part 2* (S8E26); *A Horse Shoe-In* (S9E20); *Growing Up is Hard to Do* (S9E22); *The Ending of the End – Part 1* (S9E24); and *The Last Problem* (S9E26).
